description:
Cast Wild Cantor by paying its mana cost.
When Wild Cantor enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
